meaning.zh-TW: 把「一年付幾次」換成「每次相隔幾天」用的常數；課程一律用 365。
meaning.en: The constant that turns ‘how many times a year’ into ‘how many days apart’; the course always uses 365.

meaning.zh-TW: 營業成本除以平均應付帳款，表示一年內把欠供應商的貨款付清、再欠新帳的次數。
meaning.en: Cost of sales divided by average trade payables: how many times a year the company clears what it owes suppliers and runs up a new balance.

example.zh-TW: 一家零件經銷商全年營業成本 {{money:1460000}}，平均應付帳款 {{money:200000}}，應付款項週轉率是 {{money:1460000}} ÷ {{money:200000}} ＝ {{number:7.3|unit=turns}}；平均付款天數就是 365 ÷ {{number:7.3|unit=turns}} ＝ {{number:50|unit=day}}。意思是它進貨之後平均隔 {{number:50|unit=day}} 才付錢給供應商。數字是網站自己編的，不是真實公司。
example.en: A parts distributor has cost of sales of {{money:1460000}} for the year and average trade payables of {{money:200000}}, so payables turnover is {{money:1460000}} ÷ {{money:200000}} = {{number:7.3|unit=turns}}; the average payment period is 365 ÷ {{number:7.3|unit=turns}} = {{number:50|unit=day}}. In other words, it pays its suppliers about {{number:50|unit=day}} after buying. The figures are made up for the site, not a real company.

reading.zh-TW: 天數越長，表示供應商給的信用期間越長，或公司付款越慢，等於多用了一段供應商的免費資金；天數很短則是現金提早流出。要和供應商開的付款條件比：條件是 {{number:60|unit=day}} 卻在 {{number:20|unit=day}} 就付清，是放掉了不用付利息的資金；拖到遠超過條件，供應商會收回折扣、縮短信用，甚至要求先付款。它要和平均銷貨日數、平均收現日數放在一起看，三個天數才能拼出現金轉換循環。分母用平均應付帳款，期初與期末差很多時用期末餘額會失真。常見誤讀：以為付款越快越健康，其實一般做法是在期限內付款、有現金折扣時把握折扣期，而不是比誰付得快。
reading.en: The longer the period, the more credit suppliers extend or the slower the company pays, which means more free funding from suppliers; a very short period means cash leaves early. Compare it with the terms suppliers actually offer: paying in {{number:20|unit=day}} on {{number:60|unit=day}} terms gives up interest-free money, while stretching far past the terms costs discounts, shortens credit and may end in cash-in-advance demands. Read it alongside the days to sell inventory and the collection period: the three day counts together make up the cash conversion cycle. The denominator is average trade payables, so a closing balance that differs a lot from the opening one will distort the result. A common misreading is that paying faster is always healthier; the usual practice is to pay within the terms and take any cash discount within its window, not to race.
